nodes_add.name: Mirra Alfassa (the Mother)
nodes_add.note: Born Paris 21 Feb 1878; met Aurobindo 29 March 1914; in Pondicherry from 24 April 1920; led the Sri Aurobindo Ashram from November 1926; founded Auroville 1968; died 17 Nov 1973

nodes_add.name: Auroville

nodes_update.name: Sri Aurobindo
nodes_update.note: Aurobindo Ghose; Cambridge classicist, Baroda teacher, Calcutta nationalist editor; Alipore bomb case 1908–09 (acquitted); Pondicherry from 4 April 1910; Integral Yoga, the Supermind, The Life Divine, Savitri

edges_upsert.note: The Secret of the Veda (Arya, 1914–1920) reads the Rig Veda hymns as a psychological and spiritual code
Read in Baroda; translated and commented on the Isha and Kena; Sachchidananda as the basis of The Life Divine
Had the silent Brahman realisation himself (Jan 1908) but argued against Shankara's world-negation ('Illusionism', 'The Refusal of the Ascetic') in The Life Divine
Aurobindo's essay 'Dayananda and the Veda' calls him 'the first discoverer of the right clues'; sympathetic but independent Vedic interpretation
Aurobindo wrote (1934) that in Alipore jail Vivekananda 'was speaking with me for about 15 days' as a presence in meditation; also read his works.
Three days of meditation in Baroda, January 1908, produced the silent mind; Aurobindo declined him as guru, writing that 'a human Guru was not necessary for me'
First met 29 March 1914; together in Pondicherry from April 1920; he gave her charge of the ashram in November 1926 and called her the Mother
Founded and conceived by her; charter handwritten by her in French; inaugurated 28 Feb 1968
Entered the Sri Aurobindo Ashram in 1944 aged twelve; stayed about twenty years; New York from 1964

glossary.def: Sri Aurobindo's name (purna yoga) for a yoga that combines the paths of works, knowledge, devotion and self-perfection and aims to transform the whole of life, not only to liberate the individual.
In Sri Aurobindo's teaching, a truth-consciousness above mind that knows by identity and holds the One and the many together; the next principle he expected evolution to bring out.
In Sri Aurobindo's map, the highest plane below the Supermind: vast and luminous, the plane of the cosmic gods, but still dividing truth into separate aspects.
In Sri Aurobindo's cosmology, the descent and self-concealment of Spirit in matter, which makes evolution possible: what evolves was first involved.
In Sri Aurobindo's teaching, the evolving soul behind the personality (chaitya purusha), which grows from life to life and can guide mind, feeling and body from within.

aurobindo: Born 15 Aug 1872 Calcutta; Rangpur, Loretto Darjeeling; St Paul's Sept 1884; King's 11 Oct 1890; First in Tripos Part I May 1892; ICS riding disqualification Nov 1892; left England 12 Jan 1893 SS Carthage; Apollo Bunder 6 Feb 1893, 'vast calm'; Baroda service 18 Feb 1893; Bande Mataram 6 Aug 1906; National College 14 Aug 1906; Lele Jan 1908 Silent Brahman; arrest 2 May 1908; acquitted 6 May 1909; Uttarpara 30 May 1909; Karmayogin 19 June 1909; Chandernagore Feb 1910; Pondicherry 4 April 1910; Mirra 29 March 1914; Arya 15 Aug 1914 to 15 Jan 1921; Mother returns 24 April 1920; 24 Nov 1926 'descent of Krishna, the Overmind Godhead, into the physical'; leg 24 Nov 1938; Cripps 31 March 1942; 15 Aug 1947 broadcast; died 5 Dec 1950; vault 9 Dec 1950; Life Divine book from 1939 -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-01_SABCL/-30_Index and Glossary Volume-30/-03_Chronology .htm

Parents Krishna Dhun Ghose and Swarnalata Devi, daughter of Rajnarayan Bose; Kayastha from Konnagar; Drewett, Manchester; ICS 11th of 250; Lotus and Dagger 1891; father's death after false shipwreck news; married Mrinalini 1901 (she 14); she died Dec 1918; Devadhar rules; National College resigned 1907; 60,000 filed past; uremia; Nobel nominations Literature 1943, Peace 1950; Hegel denial; Puligandla on Shankara; Hemsell on Wilber -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sri_Aurobindo

Uttarpara Speech quotes: 'it was no longer by its high walls that I was imprisoned; no, it was Vasudeva who surrounded me'; 'but it was not the tree'; 'it was Narayana whom I found in these darkened souls and misused bodies'; 'Then He placed the Gita in my hands'; 'it is the Sanatana Dharma which for us is nationalism'; delivered 30 May 1909 -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-03_CWSA/-08_Karmayogin/-03_Uttarpara Speech.htm

Lele: 'Sit in meditation, but do not think, look only at your mind'; 'silent as a windless air on a high mountain summit'; three days; 'a human Guru was not necessary for me' (Calcutta, Feb 1908) -> https://motherandsriaurobindo.in/Sri-Aurobindo/1906-1910/realisation-of-nirvana/
'Man is a transitional being; he is not final' ('Man and Superman', Essays Divine and Human) -> https://sri-aurobindo.co.in/workings/sa/37_12/0119_e.htm

Life Divine ch.1 quotes: 'If it be true that Spirit is involved in Matter...' ; 'Life is already involved in Matter and Mind in Life' -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-03_CWSA/-21-22_The Life Divine/-01_The Human Aspiration.htm

Life Divine chapter titles 'The Triple Transformation' (XXV) and 'The Ascent towards Supermind' (XXVI) -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-03_CWSA/-21-22_The Life Divine/-56_The Triple Transformation.htm

'All life is Yoga'; 'a methodised effort towards self-perfection' -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-03_CWSA/-23-24_The Synthesis of Yoga/-01_Life and Yoga.htm

Synthesis of Yoga parts (works, integral knowledge, divine love, self-perfection); serialised in Arya Aug 1914 to Jan 1921, left incomplete -> https://motherandsriaurobindo.in/Sri-Aurobindo/books/the-synthesis-of-yoga/

The Mother: 'an aspiration vigilant, constant, unceasing'; 'rejection of the movements of the lower nature'; 'surrender of oneself and all one is and has' -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-01 Works of Sri Aurobindo/-01 English/-03_CWSA/-32_The Mother With Letters On The Mother/-01_The Mother.htm

15 Aug 1947 message: 'August 15th is my own birthday'; five dreams; 'a step in evolution which would raise man to a higher and larger consciousness'; 'the partition must go', 'the division must go' -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-03 Disciples/Varun Pabrai/-01 English/Words of Sri Aurobindo-Quick Reference/-088_August-15-1947.htm

Savitri: first manuscript 1916; nearly 24,000 lines; 12 books, 49 cantos; Part One 1950, rest 1951; Mahabharata episode about 300 verses -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savitri:_A_Legend_and_a_Symbol

Alipore case: Muzaffarpur bomb 30 April 1908 by Khudiram Bose aimed at Kingsford, killed Mrs Kennedy; raids 2 May 1908, 32 Muraripukur Road (14 arrested incl. Barin), Aurobindo at 48 Grey Street; Beachcroft; C. R. Das; sessions trial 131 days; judgment 6 May 1909; Barin sentenced to death, reduced on appeal -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-04 Compilations/-01 English/Alipore Bomb Case/-04_A Short History Of The Case.htm

Southard (1980): Shakta imagery, nation as incarnation of Kali, neo-Vedantic justification -> https://core-cms.cambridgecore.org/core/journals/modern-asian-studies/article/political-strategy-of-aurobindo-ghosh-the-utilization-of-hindu-religious-symbolism-and-the-problem-of-political-mobilization-in-bengal/D920C166B3E8B622E4618710873FEE4B

Sethna: 'a question-mark glaring in the face of every disciple'; 'There was no failure on Sri Aurobindo's part'; body without decomposition nearly five days -> https://search.motherandsriaurobindo.in/_StaticContent/SriAurobindoAshram/-09 E-Library/-03 Disciples/Amal Kiran (K D Sethna)/-01 English/Aspects of Sri Aurobindo/-009_The sacrifice of sri aurobindo.htm
Cartier-Bresson photographs c. 24-25 April 1950, Magnum, permission via Pavitra -> https://overmanfoundation.org/henri-cartier-bresson-recalls-taking-sri-aurobindos-photographs/
Heehs: Lives of Sri Aurobindo (2008), devotee objections, delayed Indian publication, visa April 2012 extended 13 April -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Heehs

Odisha forfeiture under s.95 CrPC (295A IPC), Orissa HC pending; Madras HC s.92 CPC leave; Supreme Court (Lokur, Bobde JJ) set aside; article 7 Jan 2016 -> https://www.legallyindia.com/supreme-court/anti-aurubindo-book-action-sc-frowns-upon-litigation-involving-public-trusts-indirectly-bats-for-freedom-of-expression-20160107-7053

Auroville: inaugurated 28 Feb 1968, 124 nations; 'Auroville belongs to nobody in particular'; Foundation Act 1988; population ~3,300 (2021); BBC Newsnight 2008, Ofcom not upheld (2010); Dec 2021 tree felling; NGT stay 17 Dec 2021; NGT order 28 April 2022 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auroville
mirra-alfassa: Born Paris 21 Feb 1878; Académie Julian; Max Theon in Tlemcen 1905-06; 1914 Pondicherry 'at once recognised' him; eleven months; Japan four years; returned April 1920; charge of ashram Nov 1926; SAICE 1952; Auroville 1968; died 17 Nov 1973 -> https://www.sriaurobindoashram.org/mother/
sri-chinmoy: Entered Sri Aurobindo Ashram 1944 aged 12; about 20 years; New York 1964 -> https://srichinmoy.org/sri_chinmoy/
